about: Hand-checked corrections applied by 05_merge.py (research-census). aliases: names that mean the same business (normalised keys are unified before matching). rebrand: an entity whose sign changed; matched by a member's normalised name + street. dropAddressPattern: directory entries that are counters inside another shop (no own shopfront). insideAddressPattern: entries inside an arcade/hotel/mall: streetLevel=false.

rebrand.name: CrediaBank
rebrand.note: HSBC Greece's retail network went to Pancreta Bank (2024), which merged into Attica Bank, rebranded CrediaBank in 2025; vrisko.gr lists CREDIABANK at Kassaveti 1 (the OSM 'HSBC' address).
